description: This source file contains unit tests for the {@link BaseUnretireHandler} class, specifically testing the unretiring logic for Retireable objects within the OpenMRS system. The tests verify that the handler correctly unsets retirement-related fields.

classes.name: BaseUnretireHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior of BaseUnretireHandler when unretiring Retireable objects.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnsetTheRetiredBit
methods.description: Tests that the handle method unsets the retired flag on a Retireable object.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnsetTheRetirer
methods.description: Tests that the handle method clears the 'retiredBy' field.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnsetTheDateRetired
methods.description: Verifies that the handle method clears the 'dateRetired' field.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnsetTheRetireReason
methods.description: Checks that the handle method clears the 'retireReason' field.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotActOnAlreadyUnretiredObjects
methods.description: Ensures that the handle method does not alter objects that are already unretired.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotActOnRetiredObjectsWithADifferentDateRetired
methods.description: Verifies that the handle method does not alter objects if the 'dateRetired' does not match the expected date.
